items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Hyper-V allows hypervisor escape, compromising host isolation and guest virtual machines.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致 Hypervisor 逃逸，破坏主机隔离性并危及客户机虚拟机。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Graphics Component facilitates remote code execution via processed image files, representing a common malware delivery vector.
items.reason_zh: Graphics Component 中的堆溢出漏洞可通过处理过的图像文件实现远程代码执行，是常见的恶意软件投递向量。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the SMB Client enables remote code execution over networks, leveraging a historically targeted and widely exploited protocol.
items.reason_zh: SMB Client 中的释放后使用漏洞可利用历史上常被针对且广泛被利用的网络协议实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Secure Socket Tunneling Protocol (SSTP) allows remote code execution in the VPN service, impacting secure remote access deployments.
items.reason_zh: Secure Socket Tunneling Protocol (SSTP) 中的释放后使用漏洞可在 VPN 服务中实现远程代码执行，影响安全远程访问部署。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Shell enables remote code execution over the network. Its critical severity and widespread deployment make it a prime target for initial access campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Windows Shell 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致通过网络进行远程代码执行。其关键级别的严重程度和广泛部署使其成为初始访问活动的主要目标。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows HTTP Print Provider allows remote code execution without user interaction. This poses a significant threat to endpoint security due to the ubiquity of print service configurations.
items.reason_zh: Windows HTTP Print Provider 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可在无需用户交互的情况下实现远程代码执行。由于打印服务配置极为普遍，这对端点安全构成重大威胁。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Windows DirectShow permits remote code execution via malicious media files. Legacy multimedia parsing remains a high-value attack surface for drive-by exploits.
items.reason_zh: Windows DirectShow 中的越界读取漏洞可通过恶意媒体文件实现远程代码执行。遗留的多媒体解析功能仍是驱动式攻击的高价值攻击面。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the Microsoft Windows PDF parser leads to remote code execution. Document-centric malware distribution makes this vulnerability highly actionable for threat actors.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Windows PDF parser 中的整数溢出漏洞会导致远程代码执行。以文档为中心的恶意软件分发模式使该漏洞对威胁行为体极具可操作性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows Kernel allows remote code execution at ring 0. Compromising kernel integrity fundamentally breaks OS security boundaries and enables full system takeover.
items.reason_zh: Windows Kernel 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可在 Ring 0 级别实现远程代码执行。破坏内核完整性将从根本上瓦解操作系统安全边界，并使攻击者能够完全接管系统。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Text Shaping enables remote code execution during document or web content rendering. Text processing pipelines are frequently triggered, increasing exploit probability.
items.reason_zh: Windows Text Shaping 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可在文档或网页内容渲染期间实现远程代码执行。文本处理管道触发频繁，从而提高了漏洞被利用的概率。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Windows PowerShell allows privilege escalation over a network. Automated administrative scripts and remote management tools amplify its operational impact.
items.reason_zh: Windows PowerShell 中的路径遍历漏洞允许通过网络进行权限提升。自动化管理脚本和远程管理工具进一步放大了其实际危害。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in Microsoft Standard XPS processing facilitates remote code execution. Enterprise reliance on XPS workflows increases the likelihood of successful exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Standard XPS processing 中的整数下溢漏洞可实现远程代码执行。企业对 XPS 工作流的依赖增加了成功利用的可能性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Hello enables local privilege escalation. Biometric authentication modules handle sensitive credential data, making local exploitation highly valuable for persistent access.
items.reason_zh: Windows Hello 中的释放后使用漏洞可实现本地权限提升。生物识别认证模块处理敏感凭证数据，使得本地利用对于建立持久化访问极具价值。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in the Event Logging Service enables unauthorized remote code execution. Its extreme 9.8 CVSS score and network-accessible attack vector make it a critical priority for immediate patching.
items.reason_zh: Event Logging Service 中的越界读取漏洞可导致未授权的远程代码执行。其极高的 9.8 CVSS 评分及可网络访问的攻击向量使其成为紧急修补的关键优先级。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the USB Mass Storage Class Driver allows unauthorized network RCE. Physical plug-and-play vectors combined with driver-level access create a significant and easily exploitable attack surface.
items.reason_zh: USB Mass Storage Class Driver 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致未授权的网络 RCE。物理即插即用特性结合驱动程序级访问权限，构成了显著且易于利用的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Active Directory Domain Services enables unauthorized network RCE. Compromising AD directly facilitates enterprise-wide identity theft, credential dumping, and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致未授权的网络 RCE。入侵 AD 将直接促成全企业范围的身份窃取、凭证转储和横向移动。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows DHCP Server enables unauthorized network RCE. Targeting foundational network infrastructure services increases the risk of widespread service disruption and full server takeover.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致未授权的网络 RCE。针对基础网络基础设施服务的攻击增加了大规模服务中断和完全接管服务器的风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Media Foundation enables unauthorized network RCE. This component is commonly invoked by browsers and media players, making it highly susceptible to malicious payload delivery.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Foundation 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致未授权的网络 RCE。该组件常被浏览器和媒体播放器调用，因此极易受到恶意载荷投递的影响。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows URL Moniker enables unauthorized network RCE. Historically abused in phishing campaigns, it allows attackers to execute arbitrary code directly from malicious web links.
items.reason_zh: Windows URL Moniker 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致未授权的网络 RCE。该漏洞在网络钓鱼活动中历来被滥用，允许攻击者直接从恶意网页链接执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows Win32K enables unauthorized network RCE. Kernel graphics subsystem flaws are consistently leveraged by threat actors for reliable privilege escalation and kernel exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Windows Win32K 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致未授权的网络 RCE。内核图形子系统的缺陷始终被威胁行为体用于实现可靠的权限提升和内核利用。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client enables unauthorized network RCE. Directly impacts secure remote administration workflows and exposes RDP-dependent environments to immediate compromise.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致未授权的网络 RCE。该漏洞直接影响安全远程管理工作流，并使依赖 RDP 的环境面临即时被入侵的风险。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in the Local Security Authority Server (lsasrv) enables unauthorized network RCE. Critical for protecting domain credentials and preventing active directory compromise across corporate networks.
items.reason_zh: Local Security Authority Server (lsasrv) 中的越界读取漏洞可导致未授权的网络 RCE。该漏洞对于保护域凭证及防止企业网络中的 Active Directory 遭入侵至关重要。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows NTFS enables unauthorized network RCE. File system driver vulnerabilities often serve as initial footholds for deeper system exploitation and privilege escalation chains.
items.reason_zh: Windows NTFS 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致未授权的网络 RCE。文件系统驱动程序漏洞常作为更深层次系统利用和权限提升链的初始立足点。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the Windows USB Driver enables unauthorized network RCE. Highlights persistent risks associated with peripheral device interactions and underscores the need for rigorous driver hardening.
items.reason_zh: Windows USB Driver 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致未授权的网络 RCE。这凸显了与外设交互相关的持续风险，并强调了严格进行驱动程序加固的必要性。

items.reason_en: Use of uninitialized resources in the Remote Desktop Client enables authorized network RCE. Despite a lower CVSS score, RDP client flaws frequently bypass standard authentication boundaries and enable session hijacking.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client中未初始化资源的使用可导致授权网络RCE。尽管CVSS评分较低，但RDP客户端漏洞经常绕过标准身份验证边界并实现会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Critical heap overflow in Microsoft Outlook permits remote code execution via malicious documents, targeting a ubiquitous productivity suite with high user exposure.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Outlook中的关键堆溢出漏洞允许通过恶意文档执行远程代码，该漏洞针对用户覆盖面极广的生产力套件，攻击面极高。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client allows remote code execution, exploiting a widely used administrative interface for lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行，可被利用广泛使用的管理接口进行横向移动。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Error Reporting facilitates local privilege escalation, potentially bypassing system security controls and enabling persistent access.
items.reason_zh: Windows Error Reporting中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升，可能绕过系统安全控制并实现持久化访问。

items.reason_en: Critical remote code execution via the Message Queuing service allows unauthenticated attackers to compromise networked Windows systems without prior access.
items.reason_zh: Message Queuing服务中的关键远程代码执行漏洞允许未经身份验证的攻击者在无需预先访问的情况下攻陷联网的Windows系统。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Netlogon enables unauthenticated remote code execution, directly threatening Active Directory authentication infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Netlogon中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现未经身份验证的远程代码执行，直接威胁Active Directory身份验证基础设施。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution in the DHCP Server service disrupts core network operations and provides a foothold for lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server服务中的未经身份验证的远程代码执行会破坏核心网络操作，并为横向移动提供立足点。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in the DNS server service via use-after-free attacks compromises network name resolution and facilitates widespread exploitation.
items.reason_zh: DNS server service中通过释放后使用攻击实现的远程代码执行会破坏网络名称解析，并助长大规模利用。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the RPC Runtime allows unauthenticated remote code execution on virtually all Windows hosts, creating high wormability potential.
items.reason_zh: RPC Runtime中的越界写入漏洞允许在几乎所有Windows主机上实现未经身份验证的远程代码执行，具有极高的蠕虫传播潜力。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Protocol service permits unauthenticated remote code execution, severely impacting terminal server security.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Protocol服务中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，严重危及终端服务器安全。

items.reason_en: Kerberos authentication bypass via capture-replay attacks undermines identity verification, enabling attackers to impersonate users and escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: 通过捕获重放攻击绕过Kerberos身份验证破坏了身份核验机制，使攻击者能够冒充用户并提升权限。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in the Key Distribution Center compromises a critical Active Directory component, potentially leading to full domain controller takeover.
items.reason_zh: Key Distribution Center中的释放后使用漏洞会破坏关键的Active Directory组件，可能导致域控制器完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: Privilege escalation in the Hyper-V hypervisor layer could allow guest virtual machines to escape isolation and compromise the underlying host system.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V虚拟机管理层中的权限提升漏洞可能允许客户机虚拟机逃逸隔离环境，从而攻陷底层宿主机系统。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution via malicious Microsoft Office Access files remains a highly effective vector for targeted phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: 通过恶意Microsoft Office Access文件实现的未经身份验证的远程代码执行仍是定向钓鱼攻击的高效攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution in Windows Remote Desktop Services poses a critical threat to widely deployed terminal servers. Attackers can fully compromise host systems without prior credentials, enabling immediate lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Windows Remote Desktop Services中的未经身份验证的远程代码执行对广泛部署的终端服务器构成严重威胁。攻击者可在无凭据的情况下完全攻陷宿主机系统，实现即时横向移动。

items.reason_en: The NTFS driver flaw allows unauthenticated network-based code execution, directly impacting core file system operations. This enables immediate system takeover when processing network-mounted volumes or shared drives.
items.reason_zh: NTFS driver缺陷允许未经身份验证的网络代码执行，直接影响核心文件系统操作。在处理网络挂载卷或共享驱动器时可立即导致系统接管。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in the Compressed Folder component facilitates remote code execution via malicious archives. It presents a high-value target for phishing campaigns and automated malware distribution.
items.reason_zh: Compressed Folder组件中的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过恶意压缩包实现远程代码执行。该漏洞是钓鱼活动和自动化恶意软件分发的高价值目标。

items.reason_en: Privilege escalation through Credential Providers compromises Windows authentication workflows. Successful exploitation grants attackers elevated permissions to bypass security controls and harvest credentials.
items.reason_zh: 通过Credential Providers提权会破坏Windows身份验证流程。成功利用可使攻击者获得高权限以绕过安全控制并窃取凭据。

items.reason_en: Local code execution in the NTFS driver undermines storage integrity and enables persistent malware installation. It requires local access but offers reliable rootkit capabilities for long-term persistence.
items.reason_zh: NTFS driver中的本地代码执行会破坏存储完整性并支持持久化恶意软件安装。该漏洞虽需本地访问权限，但可提供可靠的Rootkit功能以实现长期驻留。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Standard XPS allows network-based privilege escalation, posing a direct threat to Windows client workstations.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Standard XPS中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许基于网络的权限提升，直接威胁Windows客户端工作站。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the Windows Fast FAT Driver enables remote attackers to elevate privileges by exploiting file system interactions over the network.
items.reason_zh: Windows Fast FAT Driver中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞使远程攻击者能够通过利用网络文件系统交互来提升权限。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Print Spooler Components facilitates remote privilege escalation, maintaining the print spooler's historically high risk profile in enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows Print Spooler Components中的释放后使用漏洞助长远程权限提升，延续了打印后台处理程序在企业环境中历来高风险的特性。

items.reason_en: Multiple externally reported vulnerabilities in HP HPLIP enable remote code execution, privilege escalation, and unauthorized file modification on desktop systems.
items.reason_zh: HP HPLIP中多个外部报告的漏洞可导致桌面系统上的远程代码执行、权限提升及未授权的文件修改。

items.reason_en: Privilege escalation and remote code execution flaws in HP Advance software compromise desktop workstations hosting the application.
items.reason_zh: HP Advance软件中的权限提升与远程代码执行漏洞会攻陷托管该应用程序的桌面工作站。

items.reason_en: Improper context bridge configuration in Jitsi Electron SDK exposes desktop screen enumeration to any page script, violating user privacy controls.
items.reason_zh: Jitsi Electron SDK中不当的上下文桥接配置会将桌面屏幕枚举暴露给任意页面脚本，违反用户隐私保护策略。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Adobe InDesign allows arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, posing a significant threat to desktop workstations when opening malicious files.
items.reason_zh: Adobe InDesign中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许以当前用户上下文执行任意代码，在打开恶意文件时对桌面工作站构成重大威胁。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Microsoft Teams enables unauthorized network-based privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Teams中缺失的身份授权机制可导致未经授权的基于网络的权限提升。

items.reason_en: Type confusion vulnerability in Microsoft Edge (Chromium) allows unauthorized remote code execution over the network.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge (Chromium)中的类型混淆漏洞允许通过网络实施未经授权的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Microsoft PowerShell Core permits unauthorized remote code execution across networks.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft PowerShell Core中的路径遍历漏洞允许跨网络实施未经授权的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office allows unauthorized local code execution via crafted documents.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过构造的文档实施未经授权的本地代码执行。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the .NET framework enables unauthorized local code execution.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework 中的越界写入漏洞可导致未授权的本地代码执行。

items.reason_en: High-severity network-accessible buffer overflow in the iSCSI Target Service enables remote code execution without prior authentication.
items.reason_zh: iSCSI Target Service 中存在高危网络可访问缓冲区溢出漏洞，可在未进行身份验证的情况下实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Critical authorization flaw in the .NET Framework allows attackers to escalate privileges over the network by exploiting insufficient permission checks.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework 存在关键授权缺陷，攻击者可利用权限检查不足通过网络提升权限。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client permits unauthenticated remote code execution across network boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许跨网络边界的未认证远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication controls in Remote Desktop Services allow authenticated users to bypass security restrictions and elevate privileges locally.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Services 中缺失的身份验证控制机制允许已认证用户绕过安全限制并在本地提升权限。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Remote Desktop Client enables remote code execution over the network, directly threatening remote administration workflows.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的堆溢出漏洞可实现网络远程代码执行，直接威胁远程管理工作流。

items.reason_en: Known as 'ShieldBreak', this flaw allows attackers to disable Microsoft Defender protections locally, severely undermining endpoint security postures.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞被称为“ShieldBreak”，允许攻击者在本地禁用 Microsoft Defender 防护功能，严重削弱终端安全态势。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Outlook can trigger remote code execution via malicious attachments, making it a prime target for phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Outlook 中的整数溢出漏洞可通过恶意附件触发远程代码执行，使其成为网络钓鱼攻击的主要目标。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Deployment Services permits unauthenticated network-based code execution during OS provisioning tasks.
items.reason_zh: Windows Deployment Services 中的释放后使用漏洞可在操作系统配置任务期间允许未经认证的基于网络的代码执行。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Microsoft QUIC enables remote code execution over the network, impacting the core Windows networking stack.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft QUIC 中的释放后使用漏洞可实现网络远程代码执行，影响核心 Windows 网络协议栈。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Active Directory Certificate Services allows network-based code execution by authorized attackers, severely compromising PKI infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Certificate Services 中的释放后使用漏洞允许经授权的攻击者进行基于网络的代码执行，严重破坏 PKI 基础设施。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Local Security Authority Server permits remote code execution, directly threatening domain controller and enterprise authentication security.
items.reason_zh: Local Security Authority Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，直接威胁域控制器和企业身份验证安全。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows TCP/IP allows remote code execution over the network, affecting fundamental OS connectivity and stability.
items.reason_zh: Windows TCP/IP 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现网络远程代码执行，影响操作系统的基础连接性与稳定性。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in the Windows Kernel enables local privilege escalation, undermining core OS isolation mechanisms and system integrity.
items.reason_zh: Windows 内核中的不受信任指针解引用漏洞可导致本地权限提升，破坏核心操作系统隔离机制与系统完整性。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in a Windows named pipe allows local attackers to escalate privileges to SYSTEM, severely compromising endpoint security.
items.reason_zh: Windows 命名管道中的访问控制不当漏洞允许本地攻击者将权限提升至 SYSTEM，严重危及终端安全。

items.reason_en: Seagull BarTender exposes an unauthenticated .NET Remoting endpoint vulnerable to remote code execution, directly threatening workstation operations.
items.reason_zh: Seagull BarTender 暴露了一个未经身份验证的 .NET Remoting 端点，易受远程代码执行攻击，直接威胁工作站运行。

items.reason_en: Qt's QDomDocument XML parser crashes when processing malformed input, causing a remotely triggerable denial of service in desktop applications.
items.reason_zh: Qt 的 QDomDocument XML 解析器在处理畸形输入时会崩溃，导致桌面应用程序中可远程触发的拒绝服务漏洞。

items.reason_en: Improper permission preservation in Avast's sandbox minifilter driver allows a low-privileged attacker to escape file isolation and escalate to SYSTEM, directly compromising endpoint integrity.
items.reason_zh: Avast 的沙箱微型筛选器驱动程序中权限保留不当，允许低权限攻击者突破文件隔离并提升至 SYSTEM 权限，直接破坏终端完整性。

items.reason_en: Pillow's out-of-bounds write when loading specially crafted PSD images can corrupt heap memory, potentially leading to remote code execution in applications that process user-uploaded graphics.
items.reason_zh: Pillow 在加载特制 PSD 图像时发生越界写入，可能破坏堆内存，进而导致处理用户上传图形的应用程序发生远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: The GIMP file-psd plugin triggers an integer overflow during thumbnail generation, resulting in undersized heap allocations that can destabilize desktop graphic editing workflows.
items.reason_zh: GIMP 的 file-psd 插件在生成缩略图时触发整数溢出，导致堆分配过小，可能破坏桌面图形编辑工作流的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Multiple PDF parsing flaws in pdfforge PDF Architect enable remote code execution with user interaction, posing a direct threat to endpoint security.
items.reason_zh: pdfforge PDF Architect 中存在多个 PDF 解析缺陷，结合用户交互即可实现远程代码执行，对终端安全构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Heap out-of-bounds write in Red Hat GStreamer allows exploitation via crafted audio files, compromising desktop multimedia applications.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat GStreamer 中的堆越界写入漏洞可通过构造的音频文件进行利用，危及桌面多媒体应用程序。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Microsoft Authenticator allows local privilege escalation, potentially compromising multi-factor authentication credentials and secure device access.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Authenticator 中的身份验证机制不当可导致本地权限提升，可能危及多因素认证凭据与安全设备访问权限。

items.reason_en: Lack of consistent length validation in Wire protobuf readers can cause memory corruption or crashes when processing attacker-controlled messages on mobile clients.
items.reason_zh: Wire protobuf 读取器缺乏一致的长度验证，在处理移动客户端上由攻击者控制的报文时可能导致内存损坏或崩溃。

items.reason_en: Unencrypted transmission of Wi-Fi credentials during device pairing exposes mobile setups to interception attacks, compromising network security at the initial configuration stage.
items.reason_zh: 设备配对过程中 Wi-Fi 凭据采用未加密传输，使移动设备配置面临拦截攻击风险，在初始配置阶段即破坏网络安全。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Teams for Android allows authorized attackers to perform network-based spoofing.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 中的跨站脚本漏洞允许已认证的攻击者实施基于网络的欺骗攻击。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Microsoft Teams for Android allows remote code execution over the network, exposing mobile endpoints to direct compromise.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 中的路径遍历漏洞可实现网络远程代码执行，使移动终端面临直接被攻陷的风险。

items.reason_en: A double-free vulnerability in the Samsung Exynos MFC encoder driver stems from improper DMA buffer cleanup, enabling local privilege escalation or denial of service on mobile and wearable devices.
items.reason_zh: Samsung Exynos MFC 编码器驱动程序中的双重释放漏洞源于 DMA 缓冲区清理不当，可在移动和可穿戴设备上实现本地权限提升或拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the Exynos camera driver triggered by malformed messages can crash the camera subsystem, impacting device stability and user privacy on affected smartphones.
items.reason_zh: Exynos 相机驱动程序中由畸形消息触发的基于栈的缓冲区溢出可导致相机子系统崩溃，影响受影响智能手机的设备稳定性与用户隐私。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the BlueZ A2DP stack permits remote code execution upon pairing with malicious Bluetooth devices, endangering mobile and laptop endpoints.
items.reason_zh: BlueZ A2DP 协议栈中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞在与恶意蓝牙设备配对时可触发远程代码执行，危及移动设备和笔记本电脑终端。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in the Pavlok Wearable's Apple Notification Center Service handler could allow local exploitation of wearable firmware and potential data leakage.
items.reason_zh: Pavlok Wearable 的 Apple Notification Center Service 处理程序中的缓冲区溢出漏洞可能导致本地利用可穿戴设备固件并造成潜在数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow triggered by unbounded tokenization of MAC and ID inputs allows remote attackers to corrupt memory and execute code on consumer routers.
items.reason_zh: 对 MAC 和 ID 输入进行未限制分词触发的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许远程攻击者破坏内存并在消费级路由器上执行代码。

items.reason_en: Remote OS command injection in Ruijie routers enables attackers to take full control of the device and pivot into internal networks.
items.reason_zh: Ruijie 路由器中的远程操作系统命令注入漏洞使攻击者能够完全控制设备并横向移动至内部网络。

items.reason_en: Validation bypass in firmware restore archive handling allows attackers to circumvent security checks and flash malicious firmware images.
items.reason_zh: 固件恢复归档文件处理过程中的验证绕过漏洞使攻击者能够规避安全检查并刷入恶意固件镜像。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded credentials in Digital Watchdog products enable unauthenticated remote attackers to gain root-level file access via FTP, severely undermining IoT device integrity and privacy.
items.reason_zh: Digital Watchdog 产品中的硬编码凭据使未经身份验证的远程攻击者能够通过 FTP 获取根级别文件访问权限，严重破坏物联网设备的完整性与隐私性。

items.reason_en: Command injection in the WNC T-Mobile 5G Box router's ping functionality allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands.
items.reason_zh: WNC T-Mobile 5G Box 路由器的 ping 功能中存在命令注入漏洞，允许未经身份验证的远程攻击者执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in the D-Link DIR-823G router's HNAP1 service enables remote code execution, compromising home network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: D-Link DIR-823G 路由器的 HNAP1 服务中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，从而破坏家庭网络基础设施。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication on XikeStor Layer3 switches allows unauthorized retrieval of sensitive configuration data, facilitating further network exploitation.
items.reason_zh: XikeStor 三层交换机缺失身份验证机制，导致未经授权方可检索敏感配置数据，进而助长进一步的网络利用。

items.reason_en: The HID RMI driver lacks minimum buffer bounds, allowing an attacker to supply an undersized report that triggers an out-of-bounds access, potentially crashing or exploiting connected peripherals.
items.reason_zh: HID RMI 驱动程序缺乏最小缓冲区边界检查，攻击者可提交尺寸过小的报告以触发越界访问，可能导致系统崩溃或连接的外设被利用。

items.reason_en: Missing report length validation in the Wacom Bluetooth driver enables potential buffer overflows when parsing malicious wire reports from drawing tablets or IoT input devices.
items.reason_zh: Wacom 蓝牙驱动程序中缺失报告长度验证，在解析来自绘图板或物联网输入设备的恶意有线报告时可能引发缓冲区溢出。

items.reason_en: Remote buffer overflow in the Totolink router's port forwarding handler allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution on consumer IoT networking hardware.
items.reason_zh: Totolink 路由器的端口转发处理程序中存在远程缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许未经身份验证的攻击者在消费级物联网网络设备中实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Missing TLS certificate validation during firmware downloads on VEO Wi-Fi monitors enables man-in-the-middle attacks, allowing threat actors to push malicious firmware updates.
items.reason_zh: VEO Wi-Fi 监视器在下载固件期间缺失 TLS 证书验证，易受中间人攻击威胁，使攻击者能够推送恶意固件更新。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote attackers can upload dangerous file types to Dell Wyse Management Suite, leading to immediate remote code execution on thin client infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 未经身份验证的远程攻击者可将危险文件类型上传至 Dell Wyse Management Suite，从而导致瘦客户端基础设施立即发生远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Critical authorization bypass in Azure AD B2C allows privilege escalation over the network, directly undermining cloud identity and access management controls.
items.reason_zh: Azure AD B2C 中存在关键的授权绕过漏洞，允许通过网络提升权限，直接破坏云身份与访问管理控制机制。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure AI Language exposes sensitive machine learning endpoints to unauthorized network access and potential data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: Azure AI Language 缺失身份验证机制，导致敏感的机器学习端点暴露于未经授权的访问及潜在的数据外泄风险中。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification flaw in Copilot Studio enables unauthorized privilege elevation across Microsoft's generative AI platform.
items.reason_zh: Copilot Studio 中的加密签名验证缺陷使攻击者能够在微软生成式 AI 平台上实现未经授权的权限提升。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Spring Cloud Azure SDK allows attackers to escalate privileges over the network in cloud-native Java deployments.
items.reason_zh: Spring Cloud Azure SDK 中的身份验证不当问题允许攻击者在云原生 Java 部署环境中通过网络提升权限。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Azure CLI permits remote code execution during automated infrastructure provisioning and DevOps pipeline executions.
items.reason_zh: Azure CLI 中的命令注入漏洞允许在自动化基础设施配置和 DevOps 流水线执行期间进行远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in Windows Hyper-V allows local code execution, raising significant hypervisor escape risks in virtualized cloud and container environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows Hyper-V 中的不受信任指针解引用漏洞允许本地代码执行，显著增加了虚拟化云和容器环境中的 Hypervisor 逃逸风险。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Microsoft Dynamics 365 enables arbitrary command execution within a major SaaS platform, threatening multi-tenant data isolation and business workflows.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dynamics 365 中的代码注入漏洞可在主流 SaaS 平台内实现任意命令执行，威胁多租户数据隔离性与业务流程。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Microsoft Entra ID permits network-based privilege escalation, directly compromising cloud identity management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 中缺失授权机制允许基于网络的权限提升，直接危及云身份管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Microsoft Entra ID via alternate channels allows unauthorized privilege elevation, undermining core zero-trust assumptions.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 通过备用通道存在身份验证绕过漏洞，可实现未经授权的权限提升，破坏了零信任核心假设。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Power Automate enables authenticated attackers to pivot internally and escalate privileges, threatening cloud workflow automation pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Power Automate 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞使已认证攻击者能够向内网横向移动并提升权限，威胁云端工作流自动化流水线。

items.reason_en: Flawed pod identifier validation in Amazon EKS Network Policy Agent allows authenticated users to bypass network isolation between co-located pods across namespaces.
items.reason_zh: Amazon EKS Network Policy Agent 中 Pod 标识符验证存在缺陷，允许已认证用户绕过跨命名空间共置 Pod 之间的网络隔离。

items.reason_en: A race condition in Docker Sandboxes' guest-to-host socket relay allows malicious guests to bypass workspace restrictions via symlinks, potentially leading to host compromise.
items.reason_zh: Docker Sandboxes 的客户机到主机套接字中继中存在竞态条件漏洞，允许恶意客户机通过符号链接绕过工作区限制，可能导致宿主机沦陷。

items.reason_en: Critical authorization flaw in Azure Arc allows unauthorized network-based privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Azure Arc 中存在关键的授权缺陷，允许未经授权的基于网络的权限提升。

items.reason_en: Name resolution vulnerability in Azure Arc enables unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network.
items.reason_zh: Azure Arc 中的名称解析漏洞使未经授权的攻击者能够通过网络提升权限。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure Kubernetes Service permits unauthorized network-based privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Service 中缺失身份验证机制，允许未经授权的基于网络的权限提升。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Azure Logic Apps allows unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges across the network.
items.reason_zh: Azure Logic Apps 中的路径遍历漏洞允许未经授权的攻击者通过网络提升权限。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass via user-controlled keys in Microsoft Partner Center exposes sensitive network data.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Partner Center 中通过用户可控密钥实现的授权绕过漏洞会暴露敏感网络数据。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Microsoft Copilot allows unauthorized network actors to execute arbitrary commands, compromising AI-assisted development environments.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Copilot 中的命令注入漏洞允许未经授权的网络攻击者执行任意命令，从而破坏 AI 辅助开发环境。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Azure CycleCloud enables privilege escalation over the network, risking unauthorized control of containerized workloads.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中缺失的授权机制可导致网络权限提升，使容器化工作负载面临被未授权控制的风险。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Azure Storage Explorer can lead to session hijacking and elevated privileges within cloud storage management interfaces.
items.reason_zh: Azure Storage Explorer 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可能导致会话劫持，并在云存储管理界面中获得提权。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Dynamics 365 allows authenticated attackers to execute code remotely, threatening enterprise CRM operations.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics 365 中存在不信任数据反序列化漏洞，允许已认证的攻击者远程执行代码，威胁企业 CRM 运营。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Entra ID enables remote code execution over the network, posing critical risks to cloud identity management.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 中存在不信任数据反序列化漏洞，可通过网络实现远程代码执行，对云身份管理构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure Active Directory allows authenticated attackers to elevate privileges, potentially leading to full tenant compromise.
items.reason_zh: Azure Active Directory 中的服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞允许已认证的攻击者提升权限，可能导致整个租户被完全攻陷。

items.reason_en: SSRF in Microsoft Exchange Online enables remote privilege escalation, threatening enterprise email and collaboration infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Online 中的 SSRF 漏洞可实现远程权限提升，威胁企业电子邮件和协作基础设施。

items.reason_en: Deserialization flaw in Azure Service Bus allows remote code execution over the network, impacting cloud messaging and integration pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Azure Service Bus 中的反序列化缺陷允许通过网络远程执行代码，影响云消息传递和集成管道。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft HPC Pack enables remote code execution, compromising high-performance computing environments.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft HPC Pack 中存在不信任数据反序列化漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，破坏高性能计算环境。

items.reason_en: GitLab allows authenticated users to trigger remote code execution via crafted project imports that overflow Unicode codepoints, jeopardizing CI/CD pipelines.
items.reason_zh: GitLab 允许已认证用户通过构造溢出 Unicode 码点的项目导入触发远程代码执行，危及 CI/CD 流水线。

items.reason_en: Octopus Server path traversal flaw enables modification of external feeds, potentially leading to arbitrary file overwrite and remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Octopus Server 的路径遍历缺陷可被用于修改外部源，可能导致任意文件覆盖和远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Dell Wyse Management Suite contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability that permits unauthenticated remote attackers to achieve remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Dell Wyse Management Suite 存在无限制文件上传漏洞，允许未经认证的远程攻击者实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: KVM's nested virtualization fails to service local TLB flushes upon a failed VM-Enter, which can cause stale memory translations and corruption, posing a critical risk to nested hypervisor deployments.
items.reason_zh: KVM 的嵌套虚拟化在 VM-Enter 失败时未能处理本地 TLB 刷新，可能导致内存转换陈旧和数据损坏，对嵌套 Hypervisor 部署构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in vLLM's ASGI web server configuration allows unauthorized access to the OpenAI API, posing severe risks to cloud-based AI inference and serving platforms.
items.reason_zh: vLLM 的 ASGI Web 服务器配置中存在身份验证绕过漏洞，允许未授权访问 OpenAI API，对基于云的 AI 推理和服务平台构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Strimzi's ClusterOperator can be manipulated to watch unintended Kubernetes namespaces, potentially escalating privileges and disrupting multi-tenant cloud Kafka deployments.
items.reason_zh: Strimzi 的 ClusterOperator 可被操纵以监视非预期的 Kubernetes 命名空间，可能导致权限提升并破坏多租户云 Kafka 部署。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Puppet Enterprise allows authenticated administrators to execute arbitrary shell commands, compromising managed infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Puppet Enterprise 中的命令注入漏洞允许已认证的管理员执行任意 Shell 命令，从而破坏受管基础设施。

items.reason_en: Insecure handling of Kubernetes service account names in Woodpecker CI pipelines enables privilege escalation within containerized deployment environments.
items.reason_zh: Woodpecker CI 流水线中对 Kubernetes 服务账户名称的不安全处理可导致容器化部署环境中的权限提升。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Services for NFS ONCRPC XDR Driver allows remote code execution over the network with a CVSS of 9.8, severely impacting storage networking infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows Services for NFS ONCRPC XDR Driver 中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞允许通过网络远程执行代码，CVSS 评分为 9.8，严重影响存储网络基础设施。

items.reason_en: Incorrect buffer size calculation in Windows iSCSI enables remote code execution over network storage protocols, disrupting enterprise SAN environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 中的缓冲区大小计算错误可通过网络存储协议实现远程代码执行，破坏企业 SAN 环境。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Reliable Multicast Transport Driver allows remote code execution, potentially destabilizing enterprise multicast communications and routing.
items.reason_zh: Reliable Multicast Transport Driver 中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞允许远程代码执行，可能破坏企业组播通信和路由的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Windows Remote Desktop Services allows privilege escalation over the network, targeting critical remote access infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows Remote Desktop Services 中的越界读取漏洞允许通过网络进行权限提升，针对关键远程访问基础设施。

items.reason_en: Link following vulnerability in Windows Update Stack is actively exploited in the wild, allowing local privilege escalation during automated patch deployment cycles.
items.reason_zh: Windows Update Stack 中的链接跟随漏洞已在野外被积极利用，可在自动补丁部署周期中实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the DHCP Server permits remote code execution, disrupting critical IP address management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行，破坏关键的 IP 地址管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication in Windows iSCSI allows attackers to bypass security controls, risking unauthorized storage area network access.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 中的弱身份验证机制允许攻击者绕过安全控制，导致存储区域网络面临未授权访问风险。

items.reason_en: Buffer over-read in the Message Queuing Queue Manager exposes sensitive information over the network, enabling further lateral movement and reconnaissance.
items.reason_zh: Message Queuing Queue Manager 中的缓冲区越界读取漏洞会通过网络暴露敏感信息，为进一步的横向移动和侦察提供条件。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in the Routing and Remote Access Service (RRAS) grants unauthorized machine access, directly compromising network routing capabilities.
items.reason_zh: Routing and Remote Access Service (RRAS) 中的远程代码执行漏洞授予未授权机器访问权限，直接破坏网络路由能力。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows DHCP Server allows remote code execution over the network. Disruption or takeover of DHCP services can severely impact network availability and enable man-in-the-middle attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络远程执行代码。DHCP 服务的中断或接管会严重影响网络可用性，并助长中间人攻击。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free flaw in Windows DNS permits remote code execution without authentication. As DNS is foundational to network resolution, exploiting this undermines core infrastructure reliability.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的释放后使用（UAF）缺陷允许无需身份验证即可远程执行代码。由于 DNS 是网络解析的基础，利用此漏洞将削弱核心基础设施的可靠性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows RNDIS enables remote code execution over adjacent networks. Virtualized and mobile device networking stacks are particularly vulnerable to this network-layer exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Windows RNDIS 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过相邻网络远程执行代码。虚拟化和移动设备网络栈特别容易受到此类网络层利用的影响。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Windows Routing and Remote Access Service (RRAS) grants unauthorized machine access. Organizations deploying remote connectivity solutions face immediate lateral movement risks.
items.reason_zh: Windows Routing and Remote Access Service (RRAS) 中的远程代码执行漏洞授予未授权机器访问权限。部署远程连接解决方案的组织将面临直接的横向移动风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Windows DNS allows remote code execution over the network. Reinforces the critical need to patch DNS components alongside other network-facing services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS中的释放后使用漏洞允许通过网络执行远程代码。此漏洞凸显了必须将DNS组件与其他面向网络的服务同步打补丁的紧迫性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in DNS Server permits remote code execution, jeopardizing critical name resolution infrastructure and enabling widespread network disruption.
items.reason_zh: DNS服务器中的释放后使用漏洞允许远程代码执行，危及关键名称解析基础设施，并可能导致广泛的网络中断。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass by spoofing in Windows Netlogon allows adjacent attackers to impersonate domain controllers, fundamentally undermining Active Directory trust relationships.
items.reason_zh: Windows Netlogon中的通过欺骗绕过身份验证漏洞允许相邻攻击者冒充域控制器，从根本上破坏了Active Directory的信任关系。

items.reason_en: Active Directory Domain Services flaw enables unauthenticated network code execution, severely impacting enterprise identity management. Compromise leads to complete domain controller takeover and trust relationship manipulation.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory域服务缺陷允许未经身份验证的网络代码执行，严重影响企业身份管理。一旦遭利用，将导致域控制器被完全接管及信任关系被篡改。

items.reason_en: Telnet Client vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote code execution over networks. Legacy protocol support continues to serve as a reliable initial access vector for threat actors targeting outdated infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Telnet客户端漏洞允许通过网络进行未经身份验证的远程代码执行。遗留协议支持继续为针对过时基础设施的攻击者提供可靠的初始访问途径。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Media Foundation permits unauthenticated remote code execution via crafted media files. The component's broad usage across Windows versions makes it highly susceptible to automated exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Media Foundation中的整数溢出漏洞允许通过构造的媒体文件进行未经身份验证的远程代码执行。该组件在多个Windows版本中广泛使用，极易受到自动化利用。

items.reason_en: iSCSI driver buffer overflow enables network-based code execution requiring authorization. It threatens storage area network reliability and can disrupt data accessibility in virtualized environments.
items.reason_zh: iSCSI驱动程序缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现需要身份验证的基于网络的代码执行。它威胁到存储区域网络的可靠性，并可能破坏虚拟化环境中的数据可访问性。

items.reason_en: Win32K stack overflow allows network-triggered privilege escalation within the kernel graphics subsystem. Exploitation yields full system control and evades standard user-mode protections.
items.reason_zh: Win32K栈溢出漏洞允许通过网络触发内核图形子系统内的权限提升。成功利用可导致系统完全控制权，并规避标准的用户模式保护机制。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated API authentication bypass in Cisco ISE is actively exploited in the wild, allowing complete compromise of network access control policies.
items.reason_zh: Cisco ISE中的未授权API身份验证绕过漏洞已在实际环境中被积极利用，可导致网络访问控制策略被完全攻破。

items.reason_en: Remote denial-of-service causing unexpected reloads in Cisco ASA/FTD SSL VPN services is actively exploited, disrupting critical secure remote access.
items.reason_zh: Cisco ASA/FTD SSL VPN服务中导致意外重启的远程拒绝服务漏洞已被积极利用，严重干扰关键的安全远程访问功能。

items.reason_en: Critical unspecified vulnerability in the Cisco ASA/FTD/FMC suite poses a severe risk of remote code execution or complete device takeover.
items.reason_zh: Cisco ASA/FTD/FMC套件中存在的关键未公开漏洞可能导致严重的远程代码执行或设备完全接管风险。

items.reason_en: Marked in CISA KEV, this critical flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass authentication and gain root access on Cisco FMC, posing an immediate threat to enterprise network management.
items.reason_zh: 该关键漏洞已被列入CISA已知被利用漏洞目录（KEV），允许未经身份验证的远程攻击者绕过身份验证并在Cisco FMC上获取root权限，对企业网络管理构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Exposes an unauthenticated REST API in Cisco ISE that grants full administrative access, enabling attackers to compromise identity and access management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞在Cisco ISE中暴露了一个无需身份验证的REST API，授予完整的管理员访问权限，使攻击者能够入侵身份与访问管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: Allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root via insecure deserialization in the External Database Access feature of Cisco FMC.
items.reason_zh: 通过Cisco FMC外部数据库访问功能中的不安全反序列化，允许以root权限进行未经身份验证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Enables arbitrary code execution and full administrative control over Arista switches via a malicious gNPSI request, compromising core switching fabric security.
items.reason_zh: 通过恶意的gNPSI请求实现任意代码执行及对Arista交换机的完全管理员控制，从而破坏核心交换架构的安全性。

items.reason_en: Privilege escalation via the gNSI Certz service on Arista EOS allows authenticated users to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges, risking full network infrastructure takeover.
items.reason_zh: Arista EOS上的gNSI Certz服务存在权限提升漏洞，允许已认证用户以root权限执行任意命令，面临整个网络基础设施被接管的重大风险。

items.reason_en: Critical heap-based buffer overflow in Windows iSCSI Target Service enables unauthorized remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI目标服务中存在关键堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致未授权的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Origin validation error in Windows NAT allows unauthorized attackers to perform spoofing on adjacent networks.
items.reason_zh: Windows NAT中的源地址验证错误允许未授权攻击者在相邻网络上执行欺骗攻击。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Microsoft QUIC permits unauthorized network information disclosure.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft QUIC中的释放后使用漏洞可导致未授权的网络信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Message Queuing allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges locally.
items.reason_zh: Windows消息队列中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已获授权攻击者在本地提升权限。

items.reason_en: Capture-replay authentication bypass in Exchange Server allows attackers to escalate privileges over the network, compromising email infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server中的捕获重放身份验证绕过漏洞允许攻击者通过网络提升权限，从而破坏邮件基础设施。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows DHCP Server enables unauthenticated remote code execution on adjacent network segments.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP服务器中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许在相邻网段进行未经身份验证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: SMB Server heap overflow permits authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network, directly impacting file sharing operations.
items.reason_zh: SMB服务器堆溢出漏洞允许已认证攻击者通过网络执行任意代码，直接影响文件共享操作。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Windows DNS allows attackers to escalate privileges remotely by exploiting name resolution processes.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS中的释放后使用漏洞允许攻击者通过利用名称解析过程远程提权。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows DNS enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, directly impacting core infrastructure resolution.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行未经身份验证的远程代码执行，直接影响核心基础设施的名称解析。

items.reason_en: Double free vulnerability in SSTP allows remote attackers to execute code over VPN tunnels, bypassing standard network authentication controls.
items.reason_zh: SSTP中的双重释放漏洞允许远程攻击者通过VPN隧道执行代码，从而绕过标准的网络身份验证控制。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited use-after-free in the WinSock driver allows local privilege escalation, highlighting urgent patching needs for network stack components.
items.reason_zh: WinSock驱动程序中被积极利用的释放后使用漏洞可导致本地权限提升，凸显了对网络栈组件紧急打补丁的迫切需求。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Windows Remote Access API permits local privilege escalation, weakening remote connectivity security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Windows远程访问API中的堆溢出漏洞允许本地权限提升，削弱了远程连接的安全边界。

items.reason_en: Arista EOS gRPC authorization bypass allows authenticated users to execute OpenConfig requests with elevated privileges, undermining network management security.
items.reason_zh: Arista EOS的gRPC授权绕过漏洞允许已认证用户以高权限执行OpenConfig请求，破坏了网络管理安全性。

items.reason_en: Crafted OSPFv2 packets can cause adjacency flapping and packet loss on Arista EOS platforms, disrupting critical routing protocols even with authentication enabled.
items.reason_zh: 构造的OSPFv2数据包可在Arista EOS平台上导致邻接关系震荡和丢包，即使启用了身份验证也会破坏关键路由协议。

items.reason_en: FreeRDP heap buffer overflow in Server Redirection PDU processing enables malicious RDP servers to trigger arbitrary code execution on clients.
items.reason_zh: FreeRDP 服务器重定向 PDU 处理中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可使恶意 RDP 服务器在客户端触发任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: The NVMe over TCP target driver writes beyond fixed queue buffers when processing oversized protocol data units, enabling remote attackers to corrupt kernel memory via malicious storage network traffic.
items.reason_zh: NVMe over TCP 目标驱动程序在处理超大协议数据单元时会越界写入固定队列缓冲区，使远程攻击者能够通过恶意存储网络流量破坏内核内存。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated P4Runtime exploitation on Arista EOS switches allows remote code execution with root privileges, critically compromising enterprise network infrastructure and traffic engineering.
items.reason_zh: 对 Arista EOS 交换机进行未授权的 P4Runtime 利用可实现具有 root 权限的远程代码执行，严重危及企业网络基础设施与流量工程。

items.reason_en: Heap memory corruption in MikroTik RouterOS SMB daemon via crafted SMB1 SessionSetupAndX requests enables remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on enterprise routing appliances.
items.reason_zh: 通过构造的 SMB1 SessionSetupAndX 请求，MikroTik RouterOS SMB 守护进程存在堆内存损坏漏洞，使远程攻击者能够在企业路由设备上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Critical vulnerability in Cisco IOS XR allows remote code execution, threatening core routing and switching infrastructure stability.
items.reason_zh: Cisco IOS XR 存在关键漏洞可导致远程代码执行，威胁核心路由与交换基础设施的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Session fixation flaw in Dell SmartFabric OS10 enables unauthenticated attackers to hijack management sessions and alter network configurations.
items.reason_zh: Dell SmartFabric OS10 存在会话固定缺陷，使未授权攻击者能够劫持管理会话并修改网络配置。

items.reason_en: Low-privileged users on Cisco IMC web interfaces can execute arbitrary OS commands and escalate to root, breaking data center management plane isolation.
items.reason_zh: Cisco IMC Web 界面中低权限用户可执行任意操作系统命令并提权至 root，破坏数据中心管理平面的隔离性。

items.reason_en: Permits unauthenticated attackers to upload malicious IODD files that execute persistent shell scripts with root privileges on OT devices.
items.reason_zh: 允许未授权攻击者上传恶意 IODD 文件，从而在 OT 设备上以 root 权限执行持久化 Shell 脚本。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass flaw allows unauthorized users to log in as administrators, jeopardizing operational technology device integrity.
items.reason_zh: 身份验证绕过缺陷允许未授权用户以管理员身份登录，危及 OT 设备的完整性。

items.reason_en: Command injection via operator credentials enables low-privileged attackers to escalate to root and execute arbitrary commands on industrial controllers.
items.reason_zh: 通过操作员凭据注入命令，使低权限攻击者能够提权至 root 并在工业控制器上执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Remote command injection flaws in Phoenix Contact and related OT devices allow low-privileged operators to execute root commands, directly threatening critical industrial processes.
items.reason_zh: Phoenix Contact 及相关 OT 设备存在远程命令注入漏洞，使低权限操作员能够执行 root 命令，直接威胁关键工业流程。

items.reason_en: Cleartext storage of sensitive information in NI SystemLink exposes critical industrial telemetry data to local attackers with minimal effort.
items.reason_zh: NI SystemLink 中以明文形式存储敏感信息，使本地攻击者能够轻易获取关键的工业遥测数据。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in NI SystemLink allows limited users to traverse host file systems, risking unauthorized modification of industrial configurations.
items.reason_zh: NI SystemLink 访问控制不当，允许受限用户遍历主机文件系统，可能导致工业配置被未授权修改。

items.reason_en: Low-privileged attackers can exploit command injection in Phoenix Contact/Pepperl+Fuchs devices to execute commands with root privileges, directly impacting OT environments.
items.reason_zh: 低权限攻击者可利用 Phoenix Contact/Pepperl+Fuchs 设备中的命令注入漏洞以 root 权限执行命令，直接影响 OT 环境。

items.reason_en: ScadaLTS suffers from an authorization bypass in its DWR endpoints, allowing unauthenticated actors to manipulate industrial time-series data.
items.reason_zh: ScadaLTS 的 DWR 端点存在授权绕过缺陷，允许未授权实体操纵工业时序数据。

items.reason_en: Control iD iDSecure experiences an unauthenticated denial of service due to a null reference exception in its API, disrupting physical access control systems.
items.reason_zh: Control iD iDSecure 的 API 中存在空引用异常，导致未授权拒绝服务漏洞，破坏物理访问控制系统。

items.reason_en: Code injection via Modbus CSV import in Advantech ICS gateways allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary Lua scripts, directly threatening operational technology networks.
items.reason_zh: Advantech ICS 网关通过 Modbus CSV 导入存在代码注入漏洞，允许已认证攻击者执行任意 Lua 脚本，直接威胁运营技术网络。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in the Advantech EKI-1242EIMS web management interface permits remote attackers to run system commands, risking full compromise of connected industrial control systems.
items.reason_zh: Advantech EKI-1242EIMS Web 管理界面存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许远程攻击者运行系统命令，可能导致所连接的工业控制系统被完全攻陷。

items.reason_en: Low-privileged operators can trigger command injection via AJAX endpoints, granting root-level control over critical automation devices.
items.reason_zh: 低权限操作员可通过 AJAX 端点触发命令注入，从而获得对关键自动化设备的 root 级控制权。

items.reason_en: Similar endpoint vulnerability allows command execution with elevated privileges, severely impacting OT system availability and safety.
items.reason_zh: 类似的端点漏洞允许以高权限执行命令，严重影响 OT 系统的可用性与安全性。

items.reason_en: WebSocket mount authorization bypass in djust circumvents Django's standard security chains, enabling unauthorized access to reactive server-side views.
items.reason_zh: djust 中的 WebSocket 挂载授权绕过缺陷绕过了 Django 的标准安全链，使未授权方能够访问响应式服务端视图。

items.reason_en: Arbitrary module import via client-supplied paths in djust leads to remote code execution in server-side rendered Python applications.
items.reason_zh: djust 中通过客户端提供的路径进行任意模块导入，会导致服务端渲染的 Python 应用程序发生远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unthrottled resource allocation in ASP.NET Core creates a severe denial-of-service risk for modern web applications and APIs.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中缺乏限制的资源分配为现代 Web 应用程序和 API 带来了严重的拒绝服务风险。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint enables phishing and credential theft attacks, undermining user trust and session security within web portals.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 存在跨站脚本漏洞，可导致钓鱼和凭证窃取攻击，破坏 Web 门户内的用户信任与会话安全。

items.reason_en: Integrity bypass in the Django djust package allows untrusted state restoration, violating web application trust boundaries and enabling server-side manipulation.
items.reason_zh: Django djust 包存在完整性绕过缺陷，允许恢复不受信任的状态，违反 Web 应用信任边界并启用服务端篡改。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in SharePoint permits remote code execution, exposing web-based collaboration platforms to full system compromise without valid credentials.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 缺失授权检查可导致远程代码执行，使基于 Web 的协作平台在无需有效凭据的情况下面临系统被完全攻陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Edge (Chromium) enables remote code execution, representing a critical browser exploitation vector for drive-by attacks.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge (Chromium) 存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，是用于无驱动下载攻击的关键浏览器利用向量。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in Visual Studio Code allows attackers to bypass security features and manipulate web traffic flows, impacting development pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 存在 HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞，允许攻击者绕过安全功能并操纵 Web 流量流，影响开发流水线。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server enables session hijacking and phishing attacks against enterprise mail users through crafted web requests.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 存在跨站脚本漏洞，可通过构造的 Web 请求针对企业邮件用户实施会话劫持和钓鱼攻击。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in SharePoint allows authenticated attackers to manipulate backend databases and escalate privileges within the web portal environment.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 存在 SQL 注入漏洞，允许已认证攻击者操纵后端数据库并在 Web 门户环境中提升权限。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization checks in Exchange Server permit privilege escalation, potentially granting administrative control over critical email infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中缺少授权检查可导致权限提升，可能使攻击者获得对关键电子邮件基础设施的管理控制权。

items.reason_en: JScript heap overflow enables unauthenticated remote code execution through web-delivered scripts. It remains a prime candidate for drive-by download attacks and browser exploitation kits targeting legacy web content.
items.reason_zh: JScript 堆溢出漏洞允许通过 Web 交付的脚本实现未认证的远程代码执行。该漏洞仍是针对旧版 Web 内容的免下载攻击和浏览器利用套件的首选目标。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated installation wizard flaws in UVdesk allow arbitrary database reconfiguration and super administrator account creation, fully compromising web helpdesk deployments.
items.reason_zh: UVdesk 安装向导存在未认证访问缺陷，允许任意重新配置数据库并创建超级管理员账户，从而完全破坏 Web 帮助台部署的安全性。

items.reason_en: Stored OS command injection in AVideo's CloneSite plugin enables remote code execution by exploiting unsanitized SSH password substitution in backend scripts.
items.reason_zh: AVideo 的 CloneSite 插件中存在存储型操作系统命令注入漏洞，可通过利用后端脚本中未经过滤的 SSH 密码替换实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: JWT signature verification failure in Feast allows complete role-based access control bypass, granting unrestricted read/write permissions to internal data stores.
items.reason_zh: Feast 中 JWT 签名验证失败可导致基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）被完全绕过，赋予内部数据存储无限制的读写权限。

items.reason_en: SAML assertion forgery in Red Hat Picketlink Federation permits unauthenticated authentication as any principal, breaking enterprise single sign-on trust models.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Picketlink Federation 中存在 SAML 断言伪造漏洞，允许未认证用户冒充任何主体进行身份验证，破坏企业单点登录信任模型。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Altium Enterprise Server allows unauthenticated attackers to probe internal services and exfiltrate sensitive data.
items.reason_zh: Altium Enterprise Server 中的服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞允许未认证的攻击者探测内部服务并窃取敏感数据。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated PHP object injection via improper deserialization allows remote attackers to instantiate arbitrary classes and achieve code execution.
items.reason_zh: 不正确的反序列化导致未认证的 PHP 对象注入漏洞，允许远程攻击者实例化任意类并实现代码执行。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in a popular WordPress plugin enables unauthenticated attackers to perform privileged actions, risking site compromise.
items.reason_zh: 某流行 WordPress 插件存在授权绕过漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者执行特权操作，危及网站安全。

items.reason_en: Argument injection in the video upload function allows unauthenticated attackers to write or overwrite critical system files on self-hosted media servers.
items.reason_zh: 视频上传功能存在参数注入漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者在自托管媒体服务器上写入或覆盖关键系统文件。

items.reason_en: Cross-tenant privilege escalation in Shuffle enables organization admins to reset and read API keys of other tenants, breaking multi-tenant isolation in SaaS environments.
items.reason_zh: Shuffle 中存在跨租户权限提升漏洞，允许组织管理员重置并读取其他租户的 API 密钥，破坏 SaaS 环境中的多租户隔离机制。

items.reason_en: Critical authentication engine flaw in Oracle Access Manager allows low-privilege network attackers to bypass security controls.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Access Manager 认证引擎存在严重缺陷，允许低权限网络攻击者绕过安全控制。

items.reason_en: High-severity Composer component vulnerability in Oracle WebCenter Portal enables low-privilege network compromise.
items.reason_zh: Oracle WebCenter Portal 中 Composer 组件存在高危漏洞，可导致低权限网络攻击者入侵系统。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows unauthorized attackers to perform network-based spoofing.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 存在跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，允许未授权的攻击者实施基于网络的欺骗攻击。

items.reason_en: Stored XSS in Concrete CMS arises from unvalidated timezone values on the dashboard user management page.
items.reason_zh: Concrete CMS 仪表板用户管理页面上的时区值未经验证，导致存储型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows authorized attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network.

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows remote code execution, directly targeting widely deployed web content management systems.

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in SharePoint enables privilege escalation, risking unauthorized administrative access to web portals.

items.reason_zh: froxlor 未对子域名重定向 URL 中的换行符进行验证，允许已认证的客户注入任意 Web 服务器配置指令，从而破坏托管环境。

items.reason_zh: Laravel Backpack 的文件上传功能在未进行适当验证的情况下信任磁盘相对路径，存在路径遍历和未授权文件系统访问风险。

items.reason_en: Themeum WP Mega Menu contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability exploitable by remote attackers to extract database contents from WordPress sites.

items.reason_en: TDuck survey forms lack webhook URL validation and ownership verification, allowing authenticated users to exfiltrate submission data to arbitrary external addresses.
items.reason_zh: TDuck 调查表单缺乏 Webhook URL 验证和所有权校验，允许已认证用户将提交数据外泄至任意外部地址。

items.reason_en: The Shopper e-commerce admin panel fails to enforce authorization checks on bulk deletion and allows client-side mutation of collection state, creating direct paths for unauthorized data manipulation.

items.reason_zh: J2Store Joomla 扩展存在未认证的盲 SQL 注入漏洞，攻击者无需身份验证即可提取敏感的客户和订单数据。

items.reason_zh: RestrictedPython 中的沙箱逃逸漏洞发生在自定义导入策略暴露了标准库模块时，允许恶意脚本突破受限执行环境。

items.reason_en: Incorrect key flag inference in Sequoia-OpenPGP allows attackers to bypass back-signature verification, undermining the trust model of OpenPGP implementations across various software stacks.
items.reason_zh: Sequoia-OpenPGP 中错误的密钥标志推断允许攻击者绕过后签名验证，破坏各软件栈中 OpenPGP 实现的信任模型。

items.reason_en: Incorrect default permissions in Dell Repository Manager allow remote low-privilege attackers to escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: Dell Repository Manager 中不正确的默认权限允许远程低权限攻击者进行提权。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Visual Studio Code permits remote code execution over the network, threatening developer toolchains and CI/CD pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的代码注入漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，威胁开发者工具链和 CI/CD 流水线。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in VS Code enables remote attackers to execute system commands, bypassing IDE security controls.
items.reason_zh: VS Code 中的操作系统命令注入漏洞使远程攻击者能够执行系统命令，从而绕过 IDE 安全控制。

items.reason_en: Inclusion of functionality from untrusted spheres in the VS Code Python extension allows local attackers to bypass security features, compromising development workflows.
items.reason_zh: VS Code Python 扩展中包含来自不受信域的功能，允许本地攻击者绕过安全功能，从而破坏开发工作流。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Visual Studio Code allows remote code execution over the network, impacting developer workstations and IDE security.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中缺少授权机制允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，影响开发者工作站和 IDE 安全性。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in PowerShell Core enables information disclosure over the network, affecting cross-platform scripting environments.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell Core 中的服务端请求伪造漏洞可导致网络信息泄露，影响跨平台脚本环境。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in GPAC's WebSocket handler can be triggered via manipulated payload sizes, potentially causing crashes or code execution in multimedia frameworks.
items.reason_zh: GPAC 的 WebSocket 处理器中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过篡改有效载荷大小触发，可能导致多媒体框架崩溃或代码执行。

items.reason_en: Linux kernel NTFS3 driver contains a slab-out-of-bounds write during MFT record attribute processing, posing a critical memory corruption risk across distributions.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核 NTFS3 驱动程序在处理 MFT 记录属性时存在 slab 越界写入漏洞，对各发行版构成严重的内存损坏风险。

items.reason_en: LMDeploy's RPC server implementation lacks proper input validation, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution that compromises AI model serving infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: LMDeploy 的 RPC 服务器实现缺乏适当的输入验证，允许未认证的远程代码执行，从而危及 AI 模型服务基础设施。

items.reason_en: Backstage TechDocs insufficiently validates mkdocs.yml files, enabling authenticated users to execute arbitrary Python code via unsafe YAML tags.
items.reason_zh: Backstage TechDocs 对 mkdocs.yml 文件的验证不足，使得已认证用户能够通过不安全的 YAML 标签执行任意 Python 代码。

items.reason_en: Unprotected traversal of the MDS capability array during session handling creates a race condition that can lead to use-after-free scenarios in the Ceph distributed filesystem client.
items.reason_zh: 会话处理期间对 MDS 能力数组的未受保护遍历会引发竞态条件，可能导致 Ceph 分布式文件系统客户端出现释放后使用（UAF）漏洞。

items.reason_en: Missing SRCU grace periods in the NVMe namespace allocation error path risks use-after-free vulnerabilities when concurrent readers access freed namespace structures.
items.reason_zh: NVMe 命名空间分配错误路径中缺少 SRCU 宽限期，当并发读取器访问已释放的命名空间结构时，可能引发释放后使用漏洞。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in the Linux kernel's IPv6 ICMP handling can be triggered remotely, leading to kernel panic or privilege escalation in underlying operating systems.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核 IPv6 ICMP 处理中的释放后使用漏洞可被远程触发，导致底层操作系统内核崩溃或提权。

items.reason_en: Netfilter's AVX2-accelerated set matching returns incorrect results upon expiry, potentially bypassing firewall rules and compromising overall network security posture.
items.reason_zh: Netfilter 的 AVX2 加速集合匹配在过期后会返回错误结果，可能绕过防火墙规则并破坏整体网络安全态势。

items.reason_en: Crafted archives can bypass Python tarfile extraction filters to modify permissions or access files outside the target directory, affecting countless Python-based tools.
items.reason_zh: 精心构造的归档文件可绕过 Python tarfile 提取过滤器以修改权限或访问目标目录外的文件，影响无数基于 Python 的工具。

items.reason_en: Decrypting malformed JWE objects causes a runtime panic in go-jose, potentially disrupting JWT-dependent microservices and authentication flows.
items.reason_zh: 解密格式错误的 JWE 对象会导致 go-jose 发生运行时崩溃，可能中断依赖 JWT 的微服务和身份验证流程。
